Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Class RawBlockComponent

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component.RawBlockComponent
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockComponent, WireOnlyBlockComponent
@Experimental public final class RawBlockComponent extends Object implements WireOnlyBlockComponent
An escape hatch: NBT written as is into the block's component data, merged over what the other components of the block wrote, for a wire field Paletter does not model (yet) or models with a fixed value (e.g. of("minecraft:collision_box", NbtMap.builder().putString("shape", "example:post").putByte("useVoxelShapes", (byte) 1).build()): from 26.70 Paletter sends "" and 0 there, as BDS does for the box forms). Nothing checks it against a version: every palette sends it as given, and a value a client does not expect is the caller's problem.

The key() is a path in the block's (or permutation's) components compound (. separates compounds); the value() is merged into the compound at that path: a compound into a compound key by key, any other value replacing what is there. Raw components are written after every other component of the same block or permutation, whatever their order, so they win. Two raw components of the same key replace each other, like other components of the same name().

Since:
1.0.0
